reasons: Options A, B and C are byte-identical smooth-shaded renders with no cube structure, no grid and no view labels. The brief's render rules draw every block as a cube and its checklist counts cubes (16 high, 10 wide walls, 12 wide eave, six roof tiers of 12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 2), so the smooth style is hard to check against the spec and looks less like the required render. Their layout otherwise matches: door at x=7 on the south face, two lanterns and a path below it, quoins, chiseled band, windows, and the eave overhang. Options F and G are byte-identical voxel renders. Every block is a visible cube, so height, wall width, eave overhang, the six roof tiers and the 2 x 2 apex can be counted. They are labelled 'Front, from south-east' and 'Back, from north-west', which matches the checklist's two views. The door, lanterns, path, windows, quoins, band and poppies are all present. The grid lines are dense but the build reads clearly. Option D and E are byte-identical voxel renders of the same build with thin volume-edge lines and no labels. They meet the cube-count checks as well as F and G but lack the view labels, so they rank third. Within each identical pair the ranking is a tie.
